articles.title: Trump downplays AI risks after dire expert warnings and calls to slow development down
articles.description: The US President said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

articles.title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
articles.description: Brics members agree they need a new global order but it's harder to answer what should replace it and how to get there.

articles.description: A recent spate of stark warnings about the dangers of AI has been met with scepticism by executives and investors.

articles.title: Only Roland Garros towel left, says Ukraine tennis player after Russian strike hits flat
articles.description: Dayana Yastremska says her flat took a "direct hit" by a Russian missile in Odesa, and all that left was her Roland Garros towel.

articles.title: Sweden votes in tight election that could see far-right party enter government
articles.description: Swedish voters have headed to the polls in an election that could bring a far-right party into government for the first time.

articles.title: Drone alert over Lithuania turns out to be flock of birds - as NATO jet scrambled
articles.description: A NATO fighter jet was scrambled after a possible drone sighting in Lithuanian airspace - but it turned out to be a flock of birds.
